subject.title: feat(cli): add openclaw promos to discover and claim ClawHub promotional model offers

question: Should this OpenClaw CLI ship before the ClawHub promotions API and `pluginNames` contract are live and enforced?
rationale: The PR is a new cross-repo feature whose default endpoint is currently unavailable and whose accepted payload fields do not yet match the companion contract, so a maintainer needs to choose the release sequencing and permanent contract shape.

options.title: Hold for contract alignment
options.body: Require the default ClawHub endpoint to return the schema-compatible list response and require claim to enforce or reject `pluginNames` before merge.

options.title: Accept sequenced rollout
options.body: Merge the CLI first and explicitly own that the documented command may fail or be incomplete until the ClawHub deployment and contract catch up.

options.title: Scope down the payload
options.body: Remove or reject `pluginNames` from the OpenClaw parser/docs until a later PR implements the plugin-install/enable contract.

recommendation.title: Hold for contract alignment
recommendation.body: Require the default ClawHub endpoint to return the schema-compatible list response and require claim to enforce or reject `pluginNames` before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the OpenClaw CLI branch and the companion ClawHub promotions API branch, so they are best positioned to align the cross-repo contract.
